name: Agent Playground Knowledge Checks
description: How visitors answer the Check yourself questions on the browser agent demo pages. Every answer is a DemoQuizAnswer custom event. attempt = 1 is a first try.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Answers', uniqueCount(demoCode) AS 'Session codes' FROM DemoQuizAnswer SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE outcome = 'correct') AS 'Right on the first try' FROM DemoQuizAnswer WHERE attempt = 1 SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT count(*) FROM DemoQuizAnswer FACET outcome TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 1 week ago

widgets.title: Hardest questions (most wrong on the first try)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE outcome = 'incorrect') AS 'Wrong first try (%)', count(*) AS 'First tries' FROM DemoQuizAnswer WHERE attempt = 1 FACET demoPage, question SINCE 1 week ago LIMIT 30
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE outcome = 'correct') AS 'Right first try (%)' FROM DemoQuizAnswer WHERE attempt = 1 FACET demoPage SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Times picked' FROM DemoQuizAnswer WHERE outcome = 'incorrect' FACET question, answer SINCE 1 week ago LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Tries needed to get it right

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(attempt) AS 'Average tries' FROM DemoQuizAnswer WHERE outcome = 'correct' FACET questionId SINCE 1 week ago LIMIT 30
